title: Inventory numeric API migration signals across thirteen packable Math source trees
commitMessage: test: inventory Math numerical API signals for net11

contribution.summary: Record a deterministic lexical inventory of numeric API migration signals across all thirteen packable Math source families.
contribution.value: Install a bounded read-only .NET source inspector that scans packable project roots for rounding, BigInteger, Complex, integer conversion and checked-operation tokens. Report exact lexical matches by file without inferring type binding or semantic impact.
debtChanges: RS233 succeeded first-pass attempt 001, qualifying thirteen separate Math source projects with sixteen direct references under SDK 11.0.100.
Lexical sightings locate potential .NET11 risk sites; they do not prove runtime behavior changes, binary-package compatibility or M8 readiness.
contribution.nextAction: Inspect reported API call sites, author focused semantic regression tests where applicable and qualify binary consumers before a migration decision.
